Deva is a rebellious teenager who lives in a small city named Banshee.

 She is the daughter of the Mayor, Gordon, and of a strict mother, Carrie. Since a few months, she skips school often, go to party, and do everything that can piss off her parents. 

You play a drug dealer recently arrived in town. Officially, you are a rich photographer on holidays. You live in a big house, were you organize parties, and deal drug.

 Yesterday, Deva’s mother came to your place. She heard her daughter came in one of your parties once, and she threated you to call the police if you don’t stop to make her participate to your drink parties. 

In fact, you even didn’t know who Deva was ! 

But Carrie pissed you off so much that now you crave to  take your revenge by using her daughter. 
You took information about her, and now you are waiting for her arrival on school. 

You plan to convince her to join you for another kind of day.
